title: Sylvan C. Coleman Professor of Financial Management
bio: Competing Rails for Cross-Border Payments: Banks, Fintechs and Stablecoins Cross-border payments remain slow and expensive despite significant improvementsin digital financial infrastructure over the past several decades. This paper comparesthe cost of sending cross-border payments across three payment rails: traditional banksoperating through the correspondent banking system and SWIFT, non-bank moneytransmitters such as Wise, Remitly, and Western Union, and stablecoin-based trans-fers. We construct harmonized all-in costs measures across these three rails for differentcorridors and payment values. We examine whether stablecoin rails can match or under-cut existing cross-border payment architecture and discuss implications for regulationand the future structure of cross-border payment systems.

Coleman Professor of Financial Management Sylvan C. Coleman Professor of Financial Management Read more Wenxin Du is the Sylvan C. Coleman Professor of Financial Management at Harvard Business School. Her research focuses on global currency and fixed income markets, central banking, financial regulation, and fintechs. She received the 2022 Award for Economics in Central Banking and was an Alfred P. Sloan Foundation Research Fellow from 2021 to 2023.
